profile.description:
Dia-TTS generates realistic dialogue (e.g. an audio file with two speakers) from transcripts. Please use the following format:
* pre-fix the person that is speaking with [S1] or [S2]
* to use sound effects like laughing use (laughs)

For example:
```
[S1] Dia is an open weights text to dialogue model. [S2] You get full control over scripts and voices. [S1] Wow. Amazing. (laughs) [S2] Try it now on Poe.
```
